en-US.author: ActivityWatch Contributors
en-US.description: ActivityWatch is an app that automatically tracks how you spend time on your devices.
en-US.longDescription: The goal of ActivityWatch is simple, Enable the collection of as much valuable lifedata as possible without compromising user privacy.
en-US.name: ActivityWatch
en-US.releaseNotes:
These are the release notes for ActivityWatch version v0.14.2.
New to ActivityWatch? Check out the website and the README.
Installation
See the getting started guide in the documentation.
Downloads
Classic distribution
- Windows (.exe installer)
- macOS: Intel | Apple Silicon (.dmg)
- Linux: .zip | .AppImage | .deb
Tauri distribution (experimental — native Wayland support on Linux)
- Windows (.exe installer)
- macOS: Intel | Apple Silicon (.dmg)
- Linux: .AppImage | .zip
Support ActivityWatch
ActivityWatch is free and open source, with no feature gates. If it is useful to you, AW Pro is an optional subscription that funds ongoing development.
Contributors
Thanks to everyone who contributed to this release:
@0xbrayo, @andreivince, @ErikBjare, @fanxing11, @kvnloo, @RaoufGhrissi, @TimeToBuildBob, @Yarish652, @zachsplat
